# edgeos_service_gui (Resource)

The web UI (`service gui`). There is one per router; the resource takes over the existing settings and the ID is always `gui`.

The resource owns every attribute below: one you leave out gets its default. Other options below `service gui` are left alone. Destroying the resource puts the ports back to 80 and 443, turns `older-ciphers` back on, listens on all addresses again and removes `ca-file` and `cert-file`.

**The provider talks to the router through this web UI.** Changing `https_port` or `listen_addresses` moves the endpoint the provider uses while it applies the change: the commit goes through, but the read that follows can fail, and later runs cannot reach the router until the provider's `host` and `port` match the new settings. Change them in a run of their own, then update the provider configuration. Make sure the firewall allows the new port first, or the only way back is SSH or the console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Changing https_port or listen_addresses moves the endpoint the provider
# connects to. Apply that on its own, then update the provider block.
resource "edgeos_service_gui" "this" {
  http_port        = 80
  https_port       = 443
  listen_addresses = ["192.168.1.1"]
  older_ciphers    = false
  cert_file        = "/config/auth/gui.pem"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path of a CA certificate on the router to send along with the server certificate, such as `/config/auth/ca.pem`.
- `cert_file` (String) Path of the server certificate on the router, a PEM file with the certificate and its key, such as `/config/auth/gui.pem`. Unset uses the self-signed certificate. The file has to exist before the commit.
- `http_port` (Number) Port of the plain HTTP listener, which redirects to HTTPS. Defaults to `80`.
- `https_port` (Number) Port of the HTTPS listener, which the provider connects to. Defaults to `443`.
- `listen_addresses` (Set of String) Local IPv4 or IPv6 addresses the web UI listens on (`listen-address`). Unset listens on all addresses.
- `older_ciphers` (Boolean) Accept older TLS ciphers for old browsers (`older-ciphers enable`). Defaults to `true`, as on a new router; set `false` to allow only current ciphers.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `gui`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_service_gui.this
  id = "gui"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_service_gui.example 'gui'
```
